usedFor: Pushpad delivers web push alerts through your Pushpad account, and “Send Push Notification” turns an event into one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in WooCommerce, then “Send Push Notification” in Pushpad

watchOut: Push notifications reach people outside your business, so each one waits in Needs you for your approval.
